lead: review: P3: W10 rollout runs to week 42, the week of Final acceptance (G10); D15 is due week 41. Nothing shows the last wave running, so the criterion cannot be judged. Fix: Size a closing run-in after the last wave into Implementation, so D15 and G10 rest on all 42 sites running; lengthen the phase and note it.

review: P3: Pilot (W9) is one site, yet the 42 sites are two kinds, 40 pharmacies and 2 warehouses. Warehouses are never proven live before rollout waves, which treat all sites alike. Fix: Size the pilot to cover a warehouse as well as a pharmacy, and place the two warehouses in named rollout waves.

review: P3: Data migration is sized as one rehearsal; the brief says to migrate its data, yet the pilot and each rollout wave size no live data load or cutover. Fix: Add a sized work piece for live data load and cutover to the pilot and each wave; note how many rehearsals the length assumes, for the partner to confirm.
del: review: D13: Pilot goes live week 27 (D12) but D13, the stability report behind the rollout decision, is due week 29: about two live weeks, against the 3 to 4 weeks sized. Fix: Set D12 go-live in week 26 or D13 in week 30, so the stability report covers the full 3 to 4 live weeks sized before G8 decides.
